release: Unreleased (dev branch, not tested on a console yet unless noted)
intro: We're in the final stretch of building out Omni's browser features: about 200 new features are being added on the dev branch over the coming days. After that, work moves to refinement: testing on the console, fixing what turns up, and polishing before the next release. Until then, these features are in development and not yet in a release.

items.title: Pinned tabs
items.text: D-pad left / right on a tab row in the Tabs panel, or "Pin this tab" in the hold-Cross menu. Up to 6; never in private tabs; kept after a restart.

items.title: Tab audio
items.text: Speaker icons on tabs that play sound; Triangle in the Tabs panel mutes / unmutes a tab.

items.title: Saved tab sessions
items.text: Save the open tabs under a name and open them later (Tabs panel).

items.title: Open in background tab
items.text: Open in background tab is now the first row of the hold-Cross link menu.

button.note: Then Cross: the link menu's first row (R1 shows it)
button.noteXbox: Then A: the link menu's first row (RB shows it)

items.title: Autoplay
items.text: Autoplay setting: Allow (default) / Block sound / Block all, also per site.

items.title: Continue watching
items.text: Continue watching row on the start page (needs the Resume videos add-on 1.1.0, which now keeps the page address and title of up to 30 unfinished videos; private tabs never record).

items.title: YouTube TV mode
items.text: YouTube TV mode (off by default): opens YouTube's TV app, driven with the D-pad.

button.note: Cross is Enter, Circle is Back
button.noteXbox: A is Enter, B is Back

items.title: Now playing
items.text: "Now playing" controls in the Options menu for whichever tab plays sound.

button.note: Options tile while a tab plays: pause, tracks, 10 s, mute
button.noteXbox: Options tile while a tab plays: pause, tracks, 10 s, mute

items.title: Sleep timer
items.text: Sleep timer (Options): pauses playback after 15 / 30 / 60 / 90 minutes.

button.note: Options > Now playing > Sleep timer: 15-90 min or end of video
button.noteXbox: Options > Now playing > Sleep timer: 15-90 min or end of video

items.title: Save page for later
items.text: A reading list of offline copies (hold Cross, or Options > Browse); never in private tabs.

button.note: Options > Browse, or the page menu (hold Cross)
button.noteXbox: Options > Browse, or the page menu (hold A)

items.title: Clear data for this site
items.text: Clear data for this site (Site settings): deletes the site's cookies and the page's storage after asking, then reloads.

items.title: HTTPS-only mode
items.text: HTTPS-only mode and "Ask sites not to sell or share my data" (Global Privacy Control): both off by default.

items.title: Tell sites this is Omni (off)
items.text: The " Omni/<version>" user-agent token is off by default ("Tell sites this is Omni" turns it on).

items.title: Ad block in embedded frames
items.text: uBlock's site fixes and element hiding also run inside frames from other sites (on by default).

items.title: Zoom per site
items.text: Zoom per site (50-200%, remembered per site): L2 + D-pad up / down, or "Zoom (this site)" in Options.

items.title: Controller battery
items.text: Controller battery icon in the top bar, and a "Downloaded: <title>" notice when a download finishes.

items.title: Keyboard word suggestions
items.text: Up to 3 word chips above the on-screen keyboard (D-pad up to reach them). Built-in word list only by default. "Learn words I type" is off by default; when on, words are kept in /data/omni/kb-words.txt on the console, and never from password, login/username, email, one-time-code, card or number fields, any field in a form with a password, or private tabs. "Clear learned words" deletes them; "Word suggestions" turns the chips off.

button.note: From the top row; Cross uses the word
button.noteXbox: From the top row; A uses the word

items.title: Faster JavaScript
items.text: Omni's JavaScript engine now uses its two optimizing compilers (DFG and FTL) by default. Console benchmark: 34.5 ms -> 12.7 ms on average (about 2.7x faster); YouTube's home page first appears in about 1.2 s instead of 1.8 s. Off switches: /data/omni/jsc-ftl-off.flag (FTL only), /data/omni/jsc-dfg-off.flag (both); the JavaScript JIT setting still turns all of it off.

items.title: GPU guard (groundwork for smoother scrolling)
items.text: The browser and its page processes now take turns sending work to the graphics chip. Without this, the two could collide and freeze the console when GPU page layers are on. Layers stay off by default; with the guard, 9 of 9 console runs with layers on were clean (a movie-streaming site scrolled with about 2.6x more screen updates), which is not yet enough to turn them on for everyone.

items.title: Graphics chip on by default
items.text: The screen and video conversion now use the PS5's graphics chip unless you turn it off (/data/omni/gpu-present-off.flag, /data/omni/gpu-video-off.flag). Before, they stayed on the processor unless a test flag was set, so everyday Omni ran the slower path (4K video conversion 3-5 ms per frame instead of about 0.5 ms).

items.title: Video sites with a dimmed or framed player no longer slow Omni down
items.text: Semi-transparent layers over a full-screen video are blended on the graphics chip. Console 4K test: page updates take 7-11 ms with a full-screen dim layer instead of 53-75 ms. HDR videos keep the previous path. Off switch: /data/omni/gpu-mix-off.flag.

items.title: Page screenshots
items.text: L2 + R3 saves the visible page to Downloads > Saved > Screenshots; never in private tabs.

button.note: Downloads > Saved > Screenshots (not in private tabs)
button.noteXbox: Downloads > Saved > Screenshots (not in private tabs)

items.title: Search shortcuts
items.text: Search shortcuts in the address bar ("yt lofi beats") and most-visited tiles in empty shortcut slots.

items.title: History
items.text: Search, day groups, delete a whole site, clear the last hour / today / everything.

items.title: Send a link from your phone
items.text: Send a link from your phone to Omni over the home network, with a 6-digit code (off by default).

items.title: File downloads
items.text: File downloads on pages (PDF, ZIP, attachments) go to the Downloads app when Media Downloads is on.

items.title: What's new
items.text: What's new page: opens once after Omni updates, listing the new features with their buttons and a "Try it" button; again any time from Options > Settings > What's new. Built from this changelog; nothing is fetched.

items.title: Video upscaling
items.text: Video upscaling (Browser settings, off by default): Smooth or Sharp enlargement for video shown larger than its own size (e.g. 1080p on a 4K TV), instead of repeating pixels. 1:1, smaller and HDR video are unchanged.

items.title: Keyboard
items.text: Number / phone / code fields open a big number pad; hold L3 + L1 / R1 for the previous / next text box; saved snippets; a show password toggle; emoji; more layouts and accents.

items.title: Per site
items.text: Always mute, remembered volume, auto-fullscreen video, minimum text size, cookie policy, fit page to the screen width, and hide this element for good (your own filters).

items.title: Tabs
items.text: Tab search, groups and "group tabs by site", tab switcher, close unused tabs (7 / 14 / 30 days, off by default), tab thumbnails, Lite mode for heavy sites, a crash page with choices (reload, reader view, data saver).

items.title: Video
items.text: Playback speed, seek faster by holding L1 / R1, "pause everything" (L2 + Options), a paused-video info strip (time left, ends at), background audio (off by default), YouTube cut recovery.

items.title: Privacy & safety
items.text: Clear on exit (off by default), a PIN lock for saved passwords, parental controls, guest mode.

items.title: Comfort
items.text: Night light, colour filters, magnifier, high contrast, reduce motion, OLED care (off by default), UI scale, accent colour and language, notice actions (Open / Allow once), recent notices, reader view by default per site.
